an-office-action-is-made-platform-scoped._: Item (g) reads 'PLATFORM scope on every permission this module adds'. Taken literally that covers insurer.company.link, which is an OFFICE action: an office links its own Insurer counterparty row to a registered company. This plant takes the literal reading and runs it. The expected result is a REFUSAL BY NAME from the permission grid guard, because a PLATFORM code must carry an EMPTY role list and this one names an office role — which is the system proving the literal reading wrong rather than me asserting it.
